exit 0

$ tool add w1
add name=w1 color=- count=1 count_opt=-1 wait=0s tags= dry=false verbose=false config=tool.toml format=text
$ tool -v add --count 3 -t x -ty --tag=z w2 red --wait=250ms --format json
add name=w2 color=red count=3 count_opt=3 wait=250ms tags=x,y,z dry=false verbose=true config=tool.toml format=json
$ tool add -vn5 --dry-run=true w3
add name=w3 color=- count=5 count_opt=5 wait=0s tags= dry=true verbose=true config=tool.toml format=text
$ tool add w4
add name=w4 color=- count=1 count_opt=-1 wait=1m30s tags=a,b dry=false verbose=false config=/etc/tool.toml format=text
$ tool --config cli.toml add -t only w5
add name=w5 color=- count=1 count_opt=-1 wait=1m30s tags=only dry=false verbose=false config=cli.toml format=text
$ tool add -- -w6 --blue
add name=-w6 color=--blue count=1 count_opt=-1 wait=0s tags= dry=false verbose=false config=tool.toml format=text
$ tool remove a b c
remove names=a,b,c token=s3cret config_set=true config_opt=/etc/tool.toml
$ tool --format=text remote list
remote list verbose=false count=1 color=- names=
$ tool remote show origin
remote show origin

$ tool add -h
[help, exit 0] Adds widgets.

Usage: tool add [flags] <name> [<color>]

Arguments:
  <name>                    the widget name
  [<color>]                 its color

Flags:
  -n, --count <int>         how many [default: 1]
      --wait <duration>     pause between widgets [env: NONE_WAIT]
  -t, --tag <str>           a tag [env: NONE_TAGS] [repeatable]
      --dry-run             do nothing
  -h, --help                show this help
      --version             show the version

Global flags:
  -v, --verbose             print more
  -c, --config <path>       the configuration file [default: tool.toml] [env: NONE_CONFIG]
